name: Hook rail (with skate bags)
description: Oak rail with black hooks, screwed to the wall with plugs (a skate bag with skates is ~4-5 kg). Optional triangular skate bags (~40 long x 34 high at the peak x 22 wide, like Decathlon Fit 26 L / Graf) hang by their top handle from the end hooks. Origin: back-centre at the bottom of the rail (use against.elevation). Double-click a bag to take them off.

source.notes: Skate bag sizes: Decathlon Fit 26 L 45 x 26 x 35, Decathlon 500 40 x 20 x 35, Graf 40 x 24 x 36.

coats.description: jackets hanging on the free hooks
